name: math-genius-android
description: Android wrapper for the existing Math Genius educational app

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js icon.svg icon-192.png icon-512.png www/ && npm run build:environment
scripts.build:android-icons: mkdir -p assets && cp icon-512.png assets/icon.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --android
